output.title: ACME certificate profiles: issuer configuration not visible in environment
output.content: The release note describes a new, opt-in ability to select ACME certificate profiles. The environment summary shows a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifest and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It does not show any Issuer or ClusterIssuer, or whether an ACME issuer is used, because the crds dimension is absent. The excerpt does not say whether the feature changes behaviour for existing issuers. The operator should check whether any ACME Issuer or ClusterIssuer exists and whether they want to select a profile.
